newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end lower for second day.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end lower for second day.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed slightly lower for the second straight day Tuesday as investors rang up the cash register and took a break after last week's spirited record-setting rise.

Based on early and unofficial results, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 11.31 points at 7,760.78. In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a small margin on heavy volume of 543 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
